author: KomodoLord1
body:
Age:13

Timezone:BST or GMT in Winter

Do you have Teamspeak? YEs

Do you have Discord? YEs

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? 

I don't have any experience on other servers as none of them will accept people without experience so I hope here is where I can start gaining experience.



What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? My biggest weakness is probably my reaction method where I sometimes use inappropriate language instead of keeping a calm head and figuring out the situation sensibly.This will probably not affect my moderating as I would stop this reaction method and remember to keep a calm head in situations.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? 

A leader must have qualities such as passion, understanding, management, stature, etc... I would consider myself to be a leader after leading my scrim team Crede for the past few months and this has definitely lowered the amounts of times that I react in the wrong way. In some ways I still need to learn things about leadership, and being under the control of other mods or Senior Mods would be a great learning curve for me.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

 I believe that I integrate with the community as much as I can being an active player on the forums, Discord and Teamspeak. I also think that I am better than others at listening about ideas from the community and making sure that they are forwarded to the appropriate staff team e.g (Mods or Devs)


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? 

Do you believe you have these skills? I think when listening to the community you have to use your skill of understanding and re-creating that idea in your head can be really helpful rather than thinking something completely different to what others have said. I also think that a skill you need is understanding their side of the story can be very helpful especially when looking at appeals. I believe that I have both of these skills and will be able to make a good decision in matters with these skills.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating? 

Friendliness, Understanding and Honesty 



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

 I would report this staff member to a senior moderator or adminstrator for them to make a decision as I could mistake the situation for something it isn't and I probably wouldn't have the authority to ban the person in hand.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

 I would politely ask them to calm down and stop being racial at the very least as it is very rude and if they refused I would leave them to do what they were unless it went into another channel which wasn't the nightclub. I might also tell a senior staff member, admin, other mods to keep a careful eye on the set of people.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

 I would tell the staff member in hand to take it off immediately as it is staff confidential, and also report this incident to a senior mod or admin for them to sort out or inform others.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? 

I would ask the Senior staff members to stop as they shouldn't be doing any of the harassment, removing ranks or creating channels and if they refused then I would message an administrator to help me in the situation as I can't stop them in what they are doing.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator?

 To gain experience and also fill my time, because as of lately I am not as busy as before as I have no team to lead and also not as much stuff to do in real life as well.


What does Avicus mean to you? 

It means a lot especially the community that I know so well. The server is so unique and on none of the other servers I have been on are the people more welcoming and helpful and now I think it is my turn to give my service as a moderator and give back to the community


Anything specific the staff team could do better?

I don't think at the moment that the staff team can improve apart from obviously continuing to help and moderate the server.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? 

Because of all the servers I know this is the one that got me into Minecraft and also enjoying it and this is where I like to spend most of my time with close friends and others off the internet.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

 I really do enjoy Avicus and the the thought of helping the community really appeals to me and is my next goal.

With Regards,

KomodoLord1
